title: Remote Executor
features:
> Remote Executor | Execute scripts right from your browser

I made this script for myself to help me... develop scripts. Since PC executors are getting detected, I needed to find a way to quickly write scripts on PC and execute em instantly on my tablet. I got inspired from ScriptBlox's direct execute feature and made it execute anything.

DISCLAIMER: This script saves your IP address for an hour since last interaction with the API. This is used so people don't guess your code and execute anything on your device. This also means you cannot use a VPN unless you have the same IP on both devices.
DOESN'T WORK? I don't keep my server on 24/7 but I will try to keep it on as much as possible. Want to host your own? Keep DMing me until I release backend code and I add the option to use a custom ip...
